purpose: C2(b) alternative correspondence check - candidate data ranges (file bytes from retained capture vs live bytes at computed runtime addresses)
base_rule: re-derive in same invocation as lowest prot&4 span start; must equal 0x400000

excluded.exec_phdr0: rt 0x400000-0x787c000 prot 0x4 - reads crash (igf6 record 4 never arrived)
excluded.relocation_targets: phdr3 + phdr7 file part - 1663596 relocs, live != file by design
excluded.runtime_modified: phdr7 BSS 0x93085f2-0x9633418 (incl GUA 0x93ba110; igf4 96B live dump is here, non-file-backed), TLS phdr5, PT_DYNAMIC
excluded.probe_self_copies: probe must not embed expected bytes; on-console byte_match forbidden; offline comparison only

evaluation_from_existing_data.reason: only successful live byte dump is igf4 gua_read 96B at rt 0x97ba110 in phdr7 BSS (prot 0x3) - not file-backed; igf6 records contain no byte dumps and its 8685-span readable list was not persisted
evaluation_from_existing_data.requires: one new probe launch per C2-ALTERNATIVE-SPEC.md section 7

pass_rule: 5/5 match, base 0x400000, all spans prot&1 in same invocation; bounded pass if refusals: A and B match + >=2 of C/D/E match + zero mismatches
fail_rule: any byte mismatch, or recorded base != 0x400000, or probe dies at first data read (new fact class)
tick_sco_status: UNRESOLVED - never read; image-level correspondence only; C2(b) acceptance is the controller's explicit act
